sources.snippet: ONNX port of sentence transformers/all MiniLM L6 v2 adjusted to return attention weights. This model is intended to be used for BM42 searches. Usage Here's an example of performing inference using the model with FastEmbed. Note: This model is supposed to be used with Qdrant. Vectors have to be configured with Modifier.IDF.
